fivetran-managed-data-lake:write-insert:.notes: Loads source data into Iceberg tables in customer-owned object storage using atomic Iceberg commits.
caveats: A sync can contain multiple commits; the entire sync is not a single atomic transaction

fivetran-managed-data-lake:write-insert:.notes: Writes V2 tables only; V3 tables are not created or written.

fivetran-managed-data-lake:write-merge-u.notes: Applies source updates and deletes to existing rows using the source primary key, including history-mode tables. Changes are applied by rewriting data files.
caveats: Rewrites data files instead of writing delete files, so very large update volumes cost more than merge-on-read

links.label: Write access guide for external engines

fivetran-managed-data-lake:write-merge-u.notes: Writes V2 tables only, so no V3 upsert path exists.

fivetran-managed-data-lake:merge-on-read.notes: Updates and deletes use copy-on-write. Fivetran does not write delete files, and external engines should not write merge-on-read changes to Fivetran-managed tables.

links.label: Write access guide for external engines

fivetran-managed-data-lake:merge-on-read.notes: Writes V2 tables only; no V3 merge-on-read.

links.label: Write access guide for external engines

fivetran-managed-data-lake:equality-dele.notes: Fivetran does not write equality delete files; row changes rewrite the affected data files.

links.label: Write access guide for external engines

fivetran-managed-data-lake:equality-dele.notes: Writes V2 tables only; no V3 equality deletes.

links.label: Write access guide for external engines

fivetran-managed-data-lake:position-dele.notes: Fivetran does not write position delete files; row changes rewrite the affected data files.

links.label: Write access guide for external engines

fivetran-managed-data-lake:position-dele.notes: Writes V2 tables only; no V3 position deletes.

links.label: Write access guide for external engines

fivetran-managed-data-lake:deletion-vect.notes: Deletion vectors are a V3 feature and the service writes V2 tables.
The service does not write V3 tables, so it does not write deletion vectors.

fivetran-managed-data-lake:table-creatio.notes: Creates the destination schema and tables from the source schema on the first sync.
Tables are always created as V2.

fivetran-managed-data-lake:schema-evolut.notes: New source columns are added to the destination table automatically as the source schema changes.

fivetran-managed-data-lake:type-promotio.notes: A changed source column type is applied to the destination column, including widening.
caveats: Done by replacing the column and rewriting its data files, not as a metadata-only Iceberg type promotion, so it costs more on large tables

fivetran-managed-data-lake:table-mainten.notes: Fivetran runs table maintenance for you: snapshot expiry, orphan file cleanup and file compaction.

fivetran-managed-data-lake:branching-tag.notes: Commits go to the main branch only; there is no option to write to a named branch.
Commits go to the main branch only.

fivetran-managed-data-lake:hidden-partit.notes: Fivetran writes unpartitioned tables and does not apply partition transforms.

links.label: Write access guide for external engines

fivetran-managed-data-lake:hidden-partit.notes: Fivetran writes unpartitioned tables and does not apply partition transforms.

links.label: Write access guide for external engines

fivetran-managed-data-lake:catalog-integ.notes: Commits go through Fivetran Catalog, the primary Iceberg catalog. Iceberg metadata can additionally be published to AWS Glue Data Catalog and BigLake metastore.

fivetran-managed-data-lake:aws-glue-cata.notes: Iceberg metadata can additionally be published to the AWS Glue Data Catalog when the destination is on AWS. Fivetran Catalog remains the primary catalog.

fivetran-managed-data-lake:rest-catalog:.notes: Customer-provided Iceberg REST Catalog endpoints are not supported as ingestion targets. Fivetran Managed Data Lake writes through Fivetran Catalog, which implements the Iceberg REST protocol.

fivetran-managed-data-lake:variant-type:.notes: Variant is a V3 type and is not part of the type mapping.
Variant is not part of the type mapping: semi-structured source data is not written as a variant column.

fivetran-managed-data-lake:shredded-vari.notes: Shredded variant is a V3 feature and the service writes no variant data.
The service writes no variant data, shredded or otherwise.
